displayName: LGD Crypto Guard（隐私计算守门）
description: Check whether an AI system handling sensitive data meets the three-law standard of registered, evidenced and gated before it is deployed. lgd-crypto-guard — 把 LGD 三律（有籍·有证·有门禁）翻译进隐私计算 / 数据加密与最小化 AI 应用（联邦·密文·脱敏）的合规守门器，对 AI 系统做三律自评与门禁判定（零依赖）。

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent apply safe operational sequencing and rollback awareness?
